licensed_demo.title: Big Buck Bunny
licensed_demo.evidence_scope: Bounded HTTPS range requests returned HTTP 206 for the beginning and metadata tail. MP4 headers identify a 596.48-second H.264 Main Level 3.0 video at 853 by 480 pixels and AAC-LC 48 kHz audio. Separate tests using the production player on the iPad mini 2 passed initial playback, pause, seeking, and close/resume; this offline fixture is not the runtime evidence.
